title: Apply counted Unicode decoding and display rules
problem: Byte counts alone misalign multibyte text, and decoding must respect counted boundaries.
design: Counted UTF-8 decoding, display-width tables and printability tables govern fill, alignment, precision and debug escapes. Wide output follows code-unit semantics.
tradeoffs: These are qualified fmt semantics, not terminal-specific grapheme measurement. Unicode can still be disabled explicitly.
